programme.title: Puthumai Pithan
programme.desc: Jeeva is framed and sent to a mental asylum and his family murdered when he earns the enmity of a corrupt politician. He escapes the asylum and exacts revenge on the politician who destroyed his life.

programme.title: Gummalam
programme.desc: Four friends fall in love with Rathi when she moves in into their neighbour's house. Later, the police arrest her and they all get shocked to learn about her true identity.

programme.title: Magane En Marumagan
programme.desc: Singaram, a loafer, tricks a rich man in a village and gets married to his daughter. When Singaram is accused of killing his enemy, he is forced to flee to Chennai.

programme.title: Kalai Jan
programme.desc: Pop singer Inderjeet is the main suspect after his female fans are killed by a serial killer. Divya, whose sister was a dancer in his troupe and the first target, comes to the city to find the killer.

programme.title: Dharmathin Thalaivan
programme.desc: When Raju loses his soft-spoken, loving elder brother Balu in a fight, he gives up his violent ways. However, his life changes for the better when he meets his brother's lookalike, who is a criminal.

programme.title: Chennai Ungalai Anbudan Varaverikirath
programme.desc: Three bachelors face several difficult hurdles when they move to Chennai in a bid to make something of their lives and try to overcome the internal and external troubles that they face.

programme.title: Aaranyam
programme.desc: Aravind, a young robber, falls in love with Divya who is one of his victims. But her father, a police officer, is against their relationship, so they both elope into a dense forest and live together.

programme.title: Acharam
programme.desc: Suriya, a sub-inspector, hates modern women and kills them secretly at night. When he meets Ramya, the wife of an architect, he becomes obsessed with her.

programme.title: Mugamariyaan
programme.desc: A serial killer commits a series of murders and then steals the hearts of the victims. However, when five college girls get trapped in his hands, it is up to them to decide how to escape alive.

programme.title: AGP
programme.desc: When a person loses her entire family to an accident, it leads her to a disorder along with hallucination and depression.

programme.title: Vaanatha Pola
programme.desc: Vellaichaamy sacrifices love for his three brothers, resisting marriage when he discovers his beloved intends to separate them.

programme.title: Savarikkadu
programme.desc: A group of friends decide to travel to Savarikkadu despite learning about the mysteries surrounding the place. Later, they get lost in the forest and try to find each other.

programme.title: Pakka
programme.desc: Nadiya tries to kill herself when she is separated from Pandi, her lover. However, when a lookalike of Pandi saves her, she is shocked to learn that he is not the man she loves.

programme.title: Pandiya Naadu
programme.desc: Shiva's perfect life turns upside down after his brother is killed by a dreaded gangster. Bent on revenge, Shiva turns into a ruthless killer and vows to eliminate his brother's killers.

programme.title: Ashoka
programme.desc: A master plan is hatched to assassinate the nation's prime minister. Then, an honest commando, Ashoka, makes it his mission to save and protect him at all costs.

programme.title: Naam
programme.desc: A dreaded terrorist's attempt at fleeing the country forever is foiled by the police and his brother is killed in the shootout. He then employs four out-of-work youths to hijack a plane.

programme.title: Devi
programme.desc: Devi, a Nagini from the Nagaloka, performs a special pooja on an eclipse day but is distracted by Tantra, an evil Naga punished by Nagdeva.

programme.title: I Love You Da
programme.desc: A match fixer faces tough competition when a young player decides to fight him and make his country win.

programme.title: Varalaru
programme.desc: Shivshankar, a person who uses a wheelchair, tries to make his son, Vishnu, aware of his responsibilities but to no avail. Things take a turn for the worse after Vishnu tries to rape a girl.

programme.title: Thiraipada Nagaram
programme.desc: Youngsters in Chennai seek film industry opportunities, renting a supportive house and receiving recommendations from a film production manager, but face disagreements.

programme.title: Semma Botha Aagathey
programme.desc: Chellam, a boy from a poor family, is in love with a rich girl but ignores her by focusing on his career while making his parents proud by scoring the highest in the district.

programme.title: Ettuthikkum Para
programme.desc: When a social activist locks horns with the government, it leads to the death of his son and his friends. Later, he protects an eloped couple who are hunted by their casteist relatives.

programme.title: Nageswary
programme.desc: A night before her wedding, Nagaveni and her brother are assaulted and killed by her fiance, Eashwar, and his friends. However, she rises from the dead and sets out to take revenge on them.

programme.title: Parthale Parvasam
programme.desc: Madhava and Simi's marriage comes to an end after she discovers that he has a love child. However, they remain friends and end up finding suitable partners for each other.

programme.title: Kadhale En Kadhale
programme.desc: Kritika loves Rajiv but fails to tell him. He loves Pragati, but she refuses him. A few years later, Rajiv's marriage is fixed and the girl turns out to be Pragati. Then Pragati learns about Kritika

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man
programme.desc: As pre-wedding festivities unfold, Aditya stumbles upon a secret only Prajakta’s best friend knew. Can he handle the parts of her he’s just beginning to see?

programme.title: Imperfect Shaadi
programme.desc: The episode centers on the wedding of the lead couple, where everything seemingly goes wrong. However, instead of letting the chaos ruin the day, the couple realizes that the "imperfections" of their wedding reflect the reality of their relationship. They choose to embrace the mess, focusing on their commitment to each other.

programme.title: Infection
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Diagnosis
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Complications

programme.title: Blooming Bows

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade

programme.title: Trouble Times Two

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.title: The Guardian Of The Dragon Gem

programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Time for Courage
programme.desc: Follow Mulan's courageous journey as she disguises herself to take her father's place in the Imperial Army, defending China against the Huns in this inspiring story.

programme.title: Honor For Father
programme.desc: Enjoy quick stories with Disney and Pixar girls! Join Moana, Helen Parr, and others on fun adventures. Perfect for bedtime reading in just five minutes!

programme.title: Khan To The Rescue
programme.desc: Mulan's grandmother is missing! Khan the horse alerts Mulan, who sees Grandma's hat and basket. Together, Mulan and Khan bravely search for and rescue her.

programme.title: Aurora's Homemade Holiday
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Listen To Your Heart
programme.desc: Pocahontas faces a tough choice. English settlers arrive, threatening her land and people. She must choose between her heart and protecting her village, seeking a path to peace.

programme.title: Raya'S Team
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Meet Raya, a lone warrior from the fantasy kingdom of Kumandra, and her mighty team.

programme.title: The Fight For Kumandra
programme.desc: It's up to Raya to find the last dragon and save the world of Kumandra!

programme.title: Raya And The Last Dragon
programme.desc: Raya, a warrior, seeks the last dragon to save Kumandra. She unites with a group to restore light and unity to their world in this adventure.

programme.title: Aurora And The Helpful Dragon
programme.desc: When Aurora brings a baby dragon from the forest. The little dragon tries to act like the other castle animals-a cat, a dog, a bird, even a fish-but something goes wrong every time.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Tiana's Friendship Fix Up
programme.desc: Tiana learns to heal friendships through kindness and trust. Conflicts test her, but love and understanding prove the key to lasting magical bonds.

programme.title: Meet A.R.F
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Bob builds a robotic helper for this pug pups in this Pre-Level 1 reader.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Perry
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb enter Perry in a mascot contest, and he becomes famous. But his Agent P fedora is everywhere! Will this fame expose his secret identity? Read to find out!

programme.title: Smitten With A Kitten
programme.desc: After Doc finds a toy kitten, she brings her home to meet the toys. Lambie falls in love with the little kitty and wants to adopt her. But anytime Lambie or the toys come close, the kitten runs away!

programme.title: Sealed With A Kiss
programme.desc: Ariel loves playing hide-and-seek with her little seal friend. But when the princess can't find him anywhere she begins to worry. Ariel searches the ocean to find her friend.

programme.title: Babysitting Mode
programme.desc: Jack-Jack may look like a normal baby, but don't let that cute face fool you! Follow along with narration as his babysitter finds out firsthand that this little guy can do some incredible things.

programme.title: Night Of The Giant Floating Baby Head
programme.desc: Enjoy this two-in-one Halloween-themed book starring Phineas, Ferb, and Perry the Platypus!

programme.title: Babysitter Bunga
programme.desc: Bunga becomes the unorthodox babysitter in the Pride Lands, teaching kids how to defend themselves. Follow the narration as they use his lessons to fight off the jackals!

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: This is the story of the friendly-but-forgetful blue tang fish as she tries to reunite with her loved ones, and everyone learns a few things about the true meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, the hot-shot rookie race car, is on his way to the race of a lifetime to claim the coveted Piston Cup. But Lightning hits a bump in the road along his journey.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Mater
programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.title: CRIME FILES

The Show’S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.desc: Manav Mehta is a successful industrialist whose personal life is in disarray. His parents leave home because of his uncourteous behavior. After problems at work, his car breaks down on the way to work, and he unintentionally visits the Siddhivinayak temple. This visit changes his life.

programme.title: Zakhmi Insan (dub) (dass Tamil)
programme.desc: Antony falls in love with Rajeswari who belongs to an upper caste family. When her father kills her sister for marrying a man from the lower caste, she decides to elope with Antony.

programme.title: Lootera
programme.desc: A story of a con artist, Varun who falls in love with Pakhi, daughter of a wealthy landowner. Varun and his partner deceive Pakhi's father by pretending to be archaeologists in search of a hidden treasure. But their plan goes awry when Varun starts to develop genuine feelings for Pakhi. Their love story is a poignant and tragic tale of sacrifice and redemption.

programme.title: The Shaukeens
programme.desc: Bored of their mundane lives, three 60-something men, immersed in the allure of Mauritius, rekindle their youthful spirits and compete for the attention of a vivacious social media addict, Ahana.

programme.title: Karobaar : The Business Of Love
programme.desc: Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.

programme.title: Ghar Jamai
programme.desc: Dwarka, a millionaire, is impressed by Anil, a principled man, and wants him to marry Mona, his daughter. However, after their marriage, he compels him to move into his house.

programme.title: Gunda Gardi
programme.desc: A righteous police commissioner, Karan Singh, tries to nab the notorious mafia duo, Narasimha and Kalicharan. After his brother-in-law gets murdered, he plans to take help from the eye-witness, Deepa, to get hold of the criminals.

programme.title: Dastaan
programme.desc: Vishnu, a reputed judge, is assumed to be Anil, an absconding murderer. However, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind his lookalike's existence.

programme.title: Zulm O Sitam
programme.desc: Superintendent of Police, Arun, has been assigned to lead the detail in charge of the state's Chief Minister's protection. However, things do not go as planned and the Chief Minister is killed.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Even in this modern era, there are several religious conflicts around us. We start judging a stranger based on his/her religion or culture. This short film is a humble attempt trying to reduce the distance between religions and thereby portraying religious bondage.

programme.title: Cheepatakadumpa
programme.desc: ‘CHEEPATAKADUMPA’ follows three women over less than a day as they awaken their naughty teenage alter egos when they meet again after years, unleashing mischief on each other, and in turn on the biased patriarchal belief systems of the world they were born into. In a masculine culture that is unduly serious about making the rules that women are expected to live by, Teja, Santo and Tamanna find true and happy rebellion in the gasping throes of this mischief.

programme.title: Dry Dreams

programme.title: Dadi Ka Murabba
programme.desc: Ramesh dreams of a good job but his lack of fluent English hinders him. His Dadi advises him to be self-reliant, prompting him to sell murabba with her help. His business grows, and he asked to raise the flag at his old school on Independence Day. The sarpanch tells him that as a self-reliant young individual, Ramesh can add to the nation's growth. The film shows that it takes both an individual's grit and determination and the support of loved ones to achieve the impossible.

programme.title: Firefly
programme.desc: A chance encounter with a piece from his past, leads Ved, a young man to reminisce a fateful night with his girlfriend, Daaria.

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk
programme.desc: Dawn to Dusk tells the narrative of Nisha Rawat, a young girl who lost her parents. She has skin cancer, Malignant Melanoma and her entire life revolves around the night. Nisha accepted her circumstances as they were. Her life, however, is turned upside down when she meets Suraj, a boy who works at a hospital. Dawn to Dusk becomes Nisha and Suraj's narrative.

programme.title: Dhongbaaz

programme.title: Dream Ride
programme.desc: Dream Ride is an emotional road drama about two strangers, Rajat and Raashi, whose unexpected journey together changes their perspective on life. What begins as a mistaken cab ride gradually unfolds into a heartfelt story of failures, dreams, self-discovery, and second chances. Through humor, honest conversations, and emotional moments along the way, the journey becomes more than just travel — it becomes a rediscovery of hope and the courage to begin again.

programme.title: Silent Cycle
programme.desc:
In a modest Indian household, 12-year-old Vrinda navigates the complexities of gender roles, tradition, and her own budding adolescence. Playful and spirited, she finds herself abruptly thrust into the adult world when she experiences her first menstruation during a Navratri puja. Caught between her grandmother Lata's strict adherence to tradition and her mother Aruna's sympathetic but conflicted support, Vrinda confronts the taboo surrounding menstruation and the use of unsanitary cloth rags.
Determined to change her circumstances, Vrinda takes matters into her own hands, discovering sanitary pads with the help of her younger brother, Jai. However, her newfound confidence is met with resistance from Lata, who views such modern conveniences as unnecessary expenses. This sparks a poignant clash of generations within the family, as Vrinda bravely challenges the stigma surrounding menstruation and advocates for her own health and dignity.
As tensions rise, the family's unity is tested during the Dussehra festival. In a symbolic gesture of reconciliation and progress, Vrinda, Lata, and Aruna come together to burn the effigy of Ravana, marking a small yet significant step towards breaking free from regressive traditions.

programme.title: Happily Married Part 2
programme.desc: Rani & Animesh, a couple who is having an affair with Jimmy plan to meet him on Saturday. The story unfolds as their meeting with Jimmy doesn’t go as planned.

programme.title: Half Cake

programme.title: Just Take It Easy
programme.desc: The story is basically on internal happiness. Sanjay a businessman is the CEO of Oberoi Industries. He is not happy in his life. Despite having all the materialistic pleasure not happy internally. The company celebrates its success party on its high growth. Sanjay invites a model Priyanka, his girlfriend to the party. He promises her to make the face of Oberoi Industries.

programme.title: Harela

But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Hack-her
programme.desc: Shraddha, about to leave for America through a Corporate that is currently under attack by a hacker, who is on run by the police and is currently on every news channel. Between all this is Vishesh, who truly loves Shraddha, and now even she is going, just like his parents, leaving him all alone. But not everything we see is true, a hacker on a mission, a girl with ambitions, and a lover, sounds good right? But who is who? Do we know the entire truth? Find out everything in our upcoming short film "Hack-Her"

programme.title: Ketaki
programme.desc: At dusk in Mumbai, 22-year-old Ava hoped for a moment with her neighbor Harry, who hurried past, preoccupied. At home, Harry revealed stolen cash from a bank robbery. When Aaron demanded the money at gunpoint, Harry shot him dead. Hearing the shots, Ava discovered the scene and, confessing her love for Harry, chose to stay. They buried Aaron, symbolizing a new beginning. As they prepared to flee, Ava's past caught up with them, leading to another gunshot as they escaped, with the haunting "Behri Duniya" playing on.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Wrecker
programme.desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Eelu Rani Bhag Gaye
programme.desc: Two teenagers running away from their home comes across a police officer who persuades them not to go, however Eelu & Rani have something else on their mind.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Dum Dum Deega Deega
programme.desc: The solution to your problem is often hidden in the problem itself; all you need is a different outlook. The story of a beggar child, Ajju, who lives on the streets of Mumbai, but dreams big. He challenges his unfortunate fate, with nothing but a 'different outlook' towards the situation he faces.

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Aileen Wuornos: American Boogeywoman
programme.desc: True Story that follows America’s most notorious Female Serial killer. Based on Aileen Wuorno’s early life. Back in 1976 a young Aileen arrives in Florida searching for a new life, marries a wealthy yacht club president to start as part of Florida’s high society. Tormented by her inner demons she surrenders to her murderous impulses havoc in the peaceful community.

programme.title: Riders Of Justice
programme.desc: Markus goes home to his teenage daughter, Mathilde, when his wife dies in a train crash. All appears to be a tragic accident until a mathematics geek, who was also a fellow passenger on the train, and his two colleagues show up.

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: In the near future artificial intelligence is in control of everyone's lives where emotions have become a threat. Set across three different time periods 1910, 2014 and 2044. Our actress (Léa Seydoux) decides to purify her DNA in a machine & continually falls in love with different incarnations of Louis (George MacKay)

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Motel Melati
programme.desc: You are checked in for a Pleasant stay in our Motel Melati run by the mistress of the house, Madam Melati. Things are not as they seem, our century old cursed Motel lures unsuspecting travelers where they are confronted by their worst nightmares, never to be seen again. Come and learn Madam Melati’s secret and tortured history and the truth behind her bond with the Motel.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: Memories are inescapable—painful, joyful, haunting. After inventor Gordon dies mysteriously, Sam uses his Rememory machine to probe others’ memories for the truth. A gripping noir mystery thriller unfolds. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: A team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated with supernatural powers.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Untraceable
programme.desc: A FBI secret service agent, gets caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a serial killer who knows that people will log onto an "untraceable" website where he conducts violent and painful murders LIVE on the net.

programme.title: no contest: off tour

programme.title: the curious tales of italo ferreira

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is surrounded by a group of thugs who have their rifles pointed at him. From a distance, The British officer and Kuwar Singh witness this scene and the latter tells that Indravadhan's rule over Ameerkot is gradually coming to an end. On the other hand, Raj Mata is searching for something among the set of books and at the same juncture, Gayatri arrives. Gayatri tells Raj Mata that is feeling uneasy and fears that Indravadhan seems to be in trouble. Will Indravadhan be able to set himself free from the thugs? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan asks his men to put down their weapons as he realizes that Gayatri's life is in danger. But one of Indravadhan's men shoots him and the goons flee with Gayatri. However, a stranger appears out of nowhere and hears Gayatri in distress. He apprehends the goons, rescues Gayatri and is astonished when Gayatri goes and embraces Indravadhan, who then reaches the place. Later, Rajmata continues to search for Yashodha and Chandravadhan is hopeful that Rajmata remains unaware of the fact that Yashodha is now dead. Just then, Gayatri and Indravadhan enter the scene. How will Rajmata react when she notices their condition? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The man who had saved Gayatri tells to one of his men that his fight for Ameerkot has begun and he is going to fight Indravadhan; defeat him and capture his wife. The following day, the same man visits Ameerkot and stops a ritual that Indravadhan was performing. This act infuriates every member of Ameerkot and Indravadhan asks the man to introduce himself. The man claims himself to be Avdesh Singh Chauhan, the heir of a landlord, who once owned Ameerkot's land. He demands Indravadhan to return Ameerkot back to him. What will Indravadhan's response be to Avdesh Singh Chauhan? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri acknowledges the fact how Indravadhan's grandfather won the land on which Ameerkot stands today. Gayatri decides to stop Indravadhan from fighting the battle for Ameerkot. On the other hand, Kokila and Kuwar Singh think whether this war would bring them personal victory over Indravadhan or a loss for Ameerkot. Later, Gayatri meets Indravadhan to convince and stop him from battling Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Will Indravadhan agree to his wife's request? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is all set to fight Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Gayatri, meanwhile, prays for her husband's safety. Avdesh shows up and confronts Indravadhan. He insults Indravadhan in front of the people gathered at Raj Mahal. Avdesh ties his signature anklet to one of his legs and picks up a spear. Seeing Avdesh armed with a spear, Indravadhan too exchanges his sword with a spear. Will Indravadhan be able to defeat Avdesh Singh Chauhan? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan tends to his wound which got from his battle with Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Gayatri helps him and asks whether is he hurt bad. Indravadhan tells Gayatri that he was hurt when his wife did not trust his capability. Avdesh too gets medicine applied on his wounds and he thinks about Gayatri all this while. Indravadhan meets Avdesh and they discuss about their friendship. Gayatri discusses with Raj Mata about Indravadhan's anger on her. What advice would Raj Mata give Gayatri? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.desc: After the death of Gayatri, Indravadhan declares that he would be leaving Ameerkot. He announces that from now onward Kuwar Singh would be the new king of Ameerkot. When Indravadhan is just about to leave Ameerkot, Kuwar Singh stops him and tells that somebody is more worthy than him to sit on the throne. Indravadhan is put to surprise when Kuwar SIngh tells that Badi Raani Maa would sit on the throne before he could. What will Indravadhan say now? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The crowning ceremony of Badi Raani Maa carries on but before things could slip off Indravadhan's hands, Gayatri shows up in the scene. She then confronts Badi Raani Maa, who is left shocked seeing her alive. A brief argument takes place between Gayatri and Badi Raani Maa and the latter is infuriated seeing the former alive. Badi Raani Maa pulls out a knife and is just about to stab Gayatri. At the same time, Indravadhan throws a spear at Badi Raani Maa which knocks off the knife off of her hand. What will Indravadhan's reaction be after learning the truth of Badi Raani Maa? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan learns that Badi Raani Maa had laid her plans well when she murdered Sulakshana and attempted to murder Gayatri too. Being the king of Ameerkot, Indravadhan gives the verdict where he asks Badi Raani Maa to leave Ameerkot and spend rest of her life as a prisoner in the fort of Rangoon. Badi Raani Maa and Kuwar Singh are shocked hearing Indravadhan's verdict. Indravadhan instructs Badi Raani Maa and says that she would not be allowed to meet her family anymore. Will Badi Raani Maa accept the punishment given to her? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.
